architecture_decisions: Derive #46 AppBuilderRecordedEvidence only from verified persisted Project, Work Specification, Engineering Run, accepted durable lineage, BUILD/TEST/VERIFY, and #79 provider-delivery/audit facts.
Keep #46 evaluator scoring, categories, critical failures, thresholds, and promotion authority unchanged; dynamically bind reference-suite identities to the durable runtime snapshot.
Consume #79 through a narrow read-only verified-delivery protocol during parallel development and reconcile to its accepted final contract before worker readiness.
work_items: Implement a bounded runtime evidence adapter and protected reference-suite binding under services/api/parallax_api/evaluation without adding persistence or provider authority.
Implement a restart-aware protected reference-app harness using existing #61 mutation, #68 lineage, #62/#70 provider, #46 evaluation, and explicit EngineeringRunService REVIEW boundaries.
Add deterministic positive/restart/idempotency and deliberate negative tests, then reconcile the provisional delivery protocol to accepted #79.
validations: Run focused runtime-evidence/reference-loop tests plus full API regression.
Validate P2-V0.15.10 and its committed protected DSPy evidence.
Run exact-head Workstream Spec Validation, Parallax P2 CI, and Bounded Autonomy Pilot after #79 reconciliation.
risks: Synthesizing success from incomplete persisted facts would weaken #46; fail closed rather than infer missing Project/spec/lineage/stage/provider evidence.
Parallel #79 development may change the delivery record surface; isolate it behind one narrow protocol and block readiness until exact reconciliation.
A reference harness could accidentally acquire release authority; keep merge, production promotion, deployment, credentials, storage and migrations outside its interfaces.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Persisted canonical Project/run binding
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The adapter accepts only a persisted Project-bound Engineering Run whose owner-scoped canonical `Project.id` matches `EngineeringRun.project_id`, whose Project is active, and whose repository identity matches the persisted delivery record. `workspace_ref`, caller/model input, filesystem paths, or provider metadata cannot substitute for Project identity.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Exact approved Work Specification binding
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The adapter proves the persisted Work Specification ID, Conversation ownership, APPROVED/SUPERSEDED status, revision, and canonical digest exactly match the Engineering Run binding. Wrong/stale spec identity, revision, or digest fails closed and cannot yield passing `spec.binding` evidence.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Accepted IMPLEMENT lineage truth
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Passing IMPLEMENT evidence must identify the same Project/run, bounded safe-patch artifacts/workspace/proposal/source-context digests, no external/Git/deployment mutation authority, and one accepted child lineage. The durable current lineage must match that child identity/content digest and parent relationship; stale/unrelated lineage fails closed.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Same-lineage BUILD/TEST/VERIFY truth
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Durable passing BUILD, TEST, and VERIFY attempts must each prove protected success against the exact accepted lineage/content digest, server-owned Project identity, same-lineage execution, no fresh repository checkout, and exact acceptance coverage. False stage evidence or unrelated source cannot be promoted.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Persisted provider publication/preview audit truth
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: GitHub publication and Vercel Preview observations are derived only from the accepted #79 persisted delivery record containing bounded #62/#70 provider evidence plus matching Wave 1 tool audits. DENIED, FAILED, stale-parent/source mismatch, missing preview, and non-READY preview remain distinct non-success conditions.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Bounded observable-only #46 evidence
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Constructed `AppBuilderRecordedEvidence` contains only bounded canonical IDs, normalized observations, and canonical digests. Raw source, provider payloads, credentials/tokens/headers/cookies/environment, hidden reasoning/scratchpad, arbitrary logs, and local filesystem roots are rejected or excluded.

protected_acceptance_map.title: IMPLEMENT recreation/retry idempotency
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: After accepted IMPLEMENT, recreating Session/service/runtime composition and retrying the exact IMPLEMENT operation returns the persisted accepted result without a second source mutation or a new lineage. A different/stale operation or lineage cannot be treated as replay.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Provider recreation/retry idempotency
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: After verified publication/preview, recreating #79 delivery/provider composition and retrying the same verified-source delivery reuses the persisted commit/PR/preview identities without another provider mutation. Different Project/run/lineage/provider parent cannot reuse that delivery.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Protected reference-app loop + operator REVIEW ceiling
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: The deterministic reference harness exercises Project → approved Work Spec → PLAN → bootstrap → typed proposal → safe mutation → durable lineage → exact-lineage BUILD/TEST/VERIFY → GitHub publication → READY Vercel Preview → unchanged #46 protected evaluation → explicit operator REVIEW. Evaluation/provider success alone cannot merge, production-promote, deploy, or complete REVIEW.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Deliberate negative protected rejection
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Wrong Project/spec, stale lineage/provider parent, false stage evidence, provider denial/failure, interrupted/retry edge cases, missing/non-ready preview, secret-bearing evidence, duplicate retries, and unrelated/fresh source are covered deterministically. Each fails evidence construction or yields `protected_pass=false` under unchanged #46 semantics.

protected_acceptance_map.title: #46 scoring and authority remain unchanged
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: No #46 evaluator scoring, category, minimum threshold, critical-failure, evaluator-version, or protected promotion logic is weakened or special-cased for P2-V0.15.10. The reference runtime suite uses the accepted evaluator with 1.0 aggregate/category floors and critical core requirements.

protected_acceptance_map.title: Reconciled #79 contract and exact-head integration readiness
protected_acceptance_map.protected_requirement: Before READY FOR INTEGRATION, the provisional narrow delivery protocol is reconciled to accepted #79 without a competing persistence/authority path. P2-V0.15.10 spec + authentic compiled DSPy plan, focused reference/evidence tests, full API regression, deterministic Workstream Spec Validation, Parallax P2 CI, and Bounded Autonomy Pilot all pass on the same exact head targeting `integration/wave2-app-builder`, with no merge/deploy/migration/provisioning.
